name.ja: 1/1 ザクプラくんDXセット(ランナーVer.再現パーツ付き)
name.en: 1/1 Zakupla-kun DX set (Runner Ver. with reproduction parts)

description.ja: ガンプラの楽しさを伝える『ガンプラくん』から「ザクプラくん」が登場！
description.en: "Zakupla-kun " appears from " Gunpla-kun" which conveys the fun of Gunpla!

description.ja: 選択式でランナーVer.でもディスプレイが可能！お馴染みの装備も付属。
description.en: You can also display it in RunnerVer. by selecting it! Familiar equipment is also included.

description.ja: • ザクプラくんの通常Ver.とランナーVer.を選択式でディスプレイ。
description.en: • Display Zakupla-kun's normal Ver. and Runner Ver. in a selection format.

description.ja: • 今回はPS素材の本体と、お馴染みの装備「ヒート・ホーク」「ザク・マシンガン」「ザク・バズーカ」が付属。
description.en: • This time, the main body is made of PS material and the familiar equipment "Heat Hawk ", " Zaku Machine Gun ", and " Zaku Bazooka" are included.

description.ja: • モノアイは左右に可動。
description.en: • Monoeye can move left and right.

description.ja: • 別売りの「ガンプラくん」シリーズプラモデルを揃えて劇中をイメージしたディスプレイをしよう！
description.en: • Create a display inspired by the movie by arranging the "Gunpla-kun" series plastic models (sold separately)!
